      "rationale": "Prevents secondary indexes from silently treating corrupted database records as non-existent keys or failing individual RPCs while continuing to run in a damaged state.       "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Directly improves chainstate integrity by preventing LevelDB deserialization failures from masquerading as missing coins and removes the complex `CCoinsViewErrorCatcher` indirection layer.
